text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel in engineering often reflects industry demographics rather than deliberate exclusion, though affinity bias is a recognized risk. For department head roles, commercial acumen and client relationships frequently outweigh technical tenure, making the appointment plausible on merit.

If your objective is professional feedback, future opportunities, or maintaining industry relationships, do not raise it; bringing up panel composition directly will trigger defensiveness and close communication. Instead, politely chase your written feedback focused strictly on performance criteria.

However, if you decide to consult an employment specialist regarding a potential discrimination grievance, the all-male panel, qualification disparities, and the employer's delay in providing feedback are relevant details to document and share with your advisor.
